requirement: Private filled prospect CSV should be outside the repo by default.
CSV must include all first-wave template headers.
First wave should normally contain exactly 20 rows.
Slots must be positive unique integers, normally 1 through 20.
Practice area must match approved first-wave taxonomy values.
Actual private list mode requires city, lawyer name and contact source.
Google review count must be blank or a non-negative integer.
Latest review and next follow-up dates must be blank or YYYY-MM-DD.
Allowed values are yes, no or unknown.
Plan and outreach status must use approved values.
Validation report must be sanitized and contain issue rows only, not private lawyer/contact values.
